data.title: Wire SECRET_KEY and DEBUG to DJANGO_SECRET_KEY/DJANGO_DEBUG env vars

data.to: docker-compose.yml already passes DJANGO_SECRET_KEY and DJANGO_DEBUG to the web container, but app/config/settings.py hardcodes SECRET_KEY (line 24) and DEBUG = True (line 27), so both env vars are silently ignored. Wire them up following the exact pattern HDT-3 (POSTGRES_*) and HDT-4 (DJANGO_ALLOWED_HOSTS) established: os.environ.get with a dev-safe default. SECRET_KEY default = the current insecure dev key (keeps fresh clones working with zero setup); DEBUG parses DJANGO_DEBUG truthily — compose and .env.example use '1'/'0', so define the parse rule explicitly (e.g. value in ('1','true','yes') case-insensitive) and keep default True for dev. Requested directly by Forrest during the README audit; the audit finding is recorded in the previous session summary.

data.body: Implemented per plan: SECRET_KEY from DJANGO_SECRET_KEY (insecure dev key as default), DEBUG from DJANGO_DEBUG via explicit truthy parse ('1'/'true'/'yes', case-insensitive, default '1'). Verified: manage.py check clean; DJANGO_DEBUG=0 -> DEBUG False, DJANGO_SECRET_KEY=x takes effect, defaults hold; telemetry tests 12/12 (POSTGRES_PORT=5433); e2e 8/8 against running compose stack. Commit a93d39a.

Review (cold, against plan): PASS. Diff a93d39a matches plan exactly — SECRET_KEY via os.environ.get('DJANGO_SECRET_KEY', <dev key>), DEBUG via explicit case-insensitive truthy parse with default '1', why-comment present; only settings.py + .lattice touched. Verified: manage.py check clean; DJANGO_SECRET_KEY=x DJANGO_DEBUG=0 diffsettings shows SECRET_KEY 'x'/DEBUG False, defaults give DEBUG True + dev key; parse probes TRUE/yes->True, 0/bogus->False, ' 1 '->True (strip works); DJANGO_DEBUG=0 with DJANGO_ALLOWED_HOSTS unset keeps ALLOWED_HOSTS=['localhost','127.0.0.1','0.0.0.0']; telemetry tests 12/12 OK on POSTGRES_PORT=5433; compose/.env.example already carry both vars, no changes needed. No fixes required.
